parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) that have a canonical SMILES string and a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_records, docs, and compound_structures (inner join for structures). Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5251 and standard_type IC50. Require canonical_smiles is not null and (pubmed_id is not null or doi is not null). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
